english: For the gods thee! For the All-gods thee! For all the gods thee! O Visnu, wide striding, this is thy Soma;
It should then be coupled as before with the aṅgamantras adding also the syllables of Sūrya and Viśvarūpa, the cause.

sanskrit: vinā vadham na kurvanti tāpasāḥ prāṇa yāpanam
english: The very ascetics cannot support their lives without killing creatures.

sanskrit: evam tuṣṭāḥ tatas sarve adhastāt bhāra pīḍitā
english: If offerings are made in this way, those beings that live in the nether regions, bearing the weight of the upper regions upon their heads or shoulders, become well-pleased and gratified.

english: Now that (cup) is again employed in the sacrifice: hence creatures are here produced again and again. And such-like is the Ritu cup , and suchlike the head of the one-hoofed. The Âgrayanacup, the Ukthya cup, and the Âditya cup,--after them cows are produced. Now, these are again employed in the sacrifice: hence creatures are here produced again and again.
